d: THE CLOCKWORK MENAGERIE #1 — Steam over Cogsworth. The call comes at the blue hour: the Tinker's Market needs Quokaia. Starring Quokaia (Pasor Natine), Quorine (Nafaro Galbris), Drexoria (Pafaro Lofaro), Rhelmirus (Pabris Omar). Tinkerers and their brass automatons keep the gear-city wound — and someone keeps loosening the springs.
